title: fix(objectql): an upgrade or re-install withdraws the items its new version no longer ships (#33050)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMscMg6AKHasj3ZXEDorLPH)_
Fixes #33050

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:同一个包再次注册(install-local 重装或升级)时,注册表撤下旧版本带来、新版本不再携带的条目(tool、flow、page、app、权限集……),并释放新清单不再声明的裸名与安全目录占用。
- **为什么改**:之前被新版本丢掉的 tool/flow 会一直注册到重启,并继续占着名字——另一个包声明同名会被 422 拒绝;现在热路径与重启后的状态一致。
- **风险与回滚**:改的是 `registerApp` 的再注册语义(objectql),只撤"上一次包体注册写过、这次没再写"的槽位;环境覆盖层、包体之外按包 id 注册的条目、函数占用都不动;被拒的升级照旧整体回滚(含原顺序)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(`replacingPackageBody` 与 `noteItemOrder`,风险在撤回与拒绝回滚的配合)、`packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts`(接线一处)、`packages/objectql/src/package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed.test.ts`(语义钉子)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed.test.ts`,预期 18/18 通过;其中 `[#33050]` 五条在修复前全红。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`SchemaRegistry.replacingPackageBody(packageId, manifest, register)` (new) is what the engine's `registerApp` now runs its body registration through, inside the existing restore-on-refusal run:

- `registerItem` records every slot a package's own body registration writes (`type` + storage key, only when the item's package id is the body's).
- After the body registers, for a package whose body was registered before, the slots the previous body wrote and this one did not are withdrawn, and the bare-name claims (registry types only, never the hook binder's `function` claims) and security catalog claims the new manifest no longer declares are released.
- Each withdrawn slot and claim is journaled before it is removed (`noteItem`, `noteBareNameClaim`, `noteSecurityCatalogClaim`), plus a new `noteItemOrder` so a refusal later in the run puts the slots back where they stood (the store's order is read by `listItems` and by a no-package `getItem`).
- `uninstallPackage` forgets the package's body record. The shared registry double (`registry-module-mock.ts`) carries the new member.

What is deliberately not withdrawn: an environment overlay in the bare slot (ADR-0005), an item registered under the package id outside a body (a stack residual owned by the id, a plugin's own `registerItem`), and anything on a first registration. Objects and object extensions are not items and are untouched.

The install-local door needs no change: it already re-registers through the `manifest` service and then announces `metadata:reloaded`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed.test.ts` — new `[#33050]` describe (5 cases: a clean 2.0.0 withdraws the 1.0.0-only page, app and permission set; the same body again keeps everything; an overlay and an out-of-body item are kept; a refusal later in the run restores every withdrawn item and claim in place; a dropped connector name is free once sealed while a kept one stays held). The existing control `a clean 2.0.0 upgrades as before` changes one assertion FROM `['probeup_v1_ps', 'probeup_v2_ps']` TO `['probeup_v2_ps']`: it pinned the defect for permission sets.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-bare-name-conflict.test.ts` — new `[#33050]` describe over the real door, a real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, holders sealed: the card's reproduction (tool + flow dropped by a same-version re-install, then another package installs the tool name: 200), an upgrade dropping one of two tools, and a CONTROL (still shipped ⇒ the other package is still refused 422).

<details><summary>Before the fix (origin/main e540baf88 build) — both new describes red</summary>

```
cloud-connection: Tests  2 failed | 8 passed (10)
  × a re-install of the same version without the tool and the flow withdraws both; ...
    AssertionError: expected { name: 'qa_shared_tool', …(6) } to be undefined
  × an upgrade to 1.0.1 that drops one tool withdraws it and keeps serving the tool it still ships
objectql: Tests  6 failed | 12 passed (18)   (the 5 new cases + the corrected control)
```
</details>

<details><summary>After the fix, final head c161470d5 (merged with origin/main)</summary>

```
closure build (pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cloud-connection^...' build) exit=0
@objectstack/objectql test        exit=0  Test Files 595 passed (595) · Tests 12947 passed (12947)
@objectstack/objectql typecheck   exit=0
@objectstack/cloud-connection test      exit=0  Test Files 80 passed (80) · Tests 1209 passed (1209)
@objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck exit=0
```
The cloud-connection suite reads `@objectstack/objectql` through its `dist`; the rebuilt dist carries the new verb (`grep -c replacingPackageBody packages/objectql/dist/index.js` = 6) and the door test turned green only after that rebuild.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The flow half of the card: the registry no longer holds the dropped flow after the re-install (pinned). The automation engine's own binding is withdrawn by the `metadata:reloaded` re-sync the door already announces after every install (`resyncFlowsFromProtocol` drops a flow the protocol no longer lists); that leg was NOT MEASURED here (the door harness composes no automation engine).
- Same family, not changed here and not measured: a package's objects, object extensions and picklist extensions that a new version drops are also kept until restart — they live outside the item store (`objectContributors`, `picklistExtensionContributions`) and dropping an object has table consequences, so they are out of this card's scope.
- Downstream consumers of `registerApp` (runtime, metadata-protocol, cli, the dogfood apps) are not run locally; CI's Test Core runs them.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gate families (dispatch-gates --commands at c161470d5)</summary>

72 commands derived for this change set (merge base with origin/main), each run at c161470d5 with its exit captured before any pipe:

```
dispatch-gates --ran: 72 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).
70 x exit 0, among them check:engine-double-contract, check:registry-log-declared, check:startup-registry-verdict,
  check:durability-log-level, check:test-source-alias, check:nul-bytes, check:type-check-coverage, check:type-check-debt,
  check:wildcard-fallthrough, check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main, check-empty-changeset --base origin/main
NOT MEASURED: node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test :: exit 3 (positive control pinned to a commit a shallow clone cannot reach)
NOT MEASURED: pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads :: exit 3 (needs every workspace dist; this worktree built only the cloud-connection closure)
```
Both NOT MEASURED families run in CI's Lint & Repo Gates on this PR.
</details>

**Stock boot, no withdrawal at boot (review#2's should-fix).** `examples/app-showcase` at head `c161470d5`, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/cli...' --filter '@objectstack/example-showcase^...' build` (exit 0): `OS_REGISTRY_LOG=info objectstack serve --dev --log-level debug`, health 200 after 12 s, 53 plugins, 138 seed rows. The boot stream holds 653 `[Registry]` lines and **0** `[Registry] Withdrew` lines. So no second `registerApp` under one id at boot withdraws anything. (Without `--log-level debug` the CLI prints no `[Registry]` line at all, so that reading would say nothing; the count above is from the debug stream.)
